$comment: HISTORICAL design illustration, not a supported runtime schema. No command reads or writes aidlc.lock.json. Managed plugin installs now record marketplace, tag, version, harness, and projection SHA-256 in <harness-dir>/tools/data/plugin-install-<name>.json; composition stamps track the composed source separately. The hashes and commit below are illustrative placeholders, not evidence for reproduction.

composer.$comment: historical example composer version; not consumed

core.$comment: bare-core version + content hash — the base every install starts from

test-pro.$comment: source git SHA + content hash of the fetched plugin tree

result.$comment: illustrative composed-result digest; current sync does not read or assert this field
